bundle_scope.topic: training hyperparameters, backbone-agnostic — batch size, epoch/early-stopping budget, mixed-precision, optimizer, learning rate, dropout, weight decay. Excludes model/backbone sizing (S1/S2/S3 profile, d_model, hidden_channels, num_layers, ...): those hyperparameter names and values are backbone-specific, so they're stated inline in each single-candidate row's own `architecture.hyperparam_profile`, never centralized here — a shared bundle entry would either duplicate what's already candidate-specific or be too vague to be useful.
bundle_scope.applies_to: every Optuna trial across every architecture-design candidate (whole-architecture and sub-component rows alike), per 04 § optimization strategy's single-study-across-arch-and-hparams design

optimization_mechanics.search_method: Optuna TPE, single study combining architecture choice (categorical) + this bundle's hyperparams (conditional sub-params per arch), per 04 § optimization strategy
optimization_mechanics.pruning: Hyperband via OptunaPruningCallback, reports val_loss/epoch, prunes unpromising or NaN/Inf trials; minimum grace-period epoch count before pruning kicks in, per cross-architecture fairness
optimization_mechanics.budget_control: estimate_total_budget()/max_trials_for_budget() for the trial-count cap; profile_trial_cost() measures real wall-clock+VRAM per arch+hparam combo on the RTX 4060 8GB card rather than hand-calculating
